title: Vision Models Overview
summary: This module provides a comprehensive collection of vision and multimodal models for tasks such as object detection, image and video segmentation, conditional generation, and vision-language understanding.

nodes.label: Object Detection Models
nodes.title: Object Detection Models
nodes.description: A collection of models designed to identify and localize objects within images, including various DETR-based architectures and specialized document analysis models.

nodes.label: Segmentation Models
nodes.title: Segmentation Models
nodes.description: Models for image and video segmentation, covering instance, semantic, panoptic, and universal segmentation tasks, often with prompt-based capabilities.

nodes.label: Multimodal Vision-Language Models
nodes.title: Multimodal Vision-Language Models
nodes.description: Models that integrate vision and language modalities for tasks like image captioning, visual question answering, and joint representation learning.

nodes.label: Conditional Generation Models
nodes.title: Conditional Generation Models
nodes.description: Models capable of generating text or other outputs conditionally based on visual inputs, including OCR, formula recognition, and general image-to-text tasks.

nodes.label: Video Processing Models
nodes.title: Video Processing Models
nodes.description: Models specifically designed to process video data for tasks like object tracking, segmentation, and video-text understanding.

nodes.label: Vision Encoder
nodes.title: Vision Encoder
nodes.description: Extracts visual features from input images or video frames, forming the backbone for image-based tasks.

nodes.label: Text Encoder
nodes.title: Text Encoder
nodes.description: Processes textual inputs to generate embeddings, used for text-conditioned tasks and multimodal integration.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: Language Model
nodes.description: Generates text based on processed multimodal inputs or performs causal language modeling.

nodes.label: Q-Former
nodes.title: Q-Former
nodes.description: A query transformer that processes visual features and text prompts to generate multimodal representations.

nodes.label: Image-to-Text Projection
nodes.title: Image-to-Text Projection
nodes.description: Projects image features into the text embedding space for multimodal integration and alignment.

nodes.label: Object Detection Heads
nodes.title: Object Detection Heads
nodes.description: Predicts class labels and bounding box coordinates from the model's output features.

nodes.label: Mask Decoder
nodes.title: Mask Decoder
nodes.description: Generates segmentation masks based on decoded features and prompt embeddings.

nodes.label: Prompt Encoder
nodes.title: Prompt Encoder
nodes.description: Encodes various types of prompts (points, boxes, masks) into embeddings for segmentation tasks.

nodes.label: Memory Mechanisms
nodes.title: Memory Mechanisms
nodes.description: Components for temporal consistency in video models, including memory attention and memory encoding.

nodes.label: Data Processing
nodes.title: Data Processing
nodes.description: Handles preprocessing and postprocessing of image and video data for various models.

groups.label: Core Vision Models
groups.title: Core Vision Models
groups.description: The primary models for various vision tasks, including object detection, segmentation, and multimodal understanding.

groups.label: Shared Architectural Components
groups.title: Shared Architectural Components
groups.description: Reusable building blocks and mechanisms utilized across multiple vision and multimodal models.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External Dependencies
groups.description: Modules or components that provide essential services like data preprocessing to the vision models.
